Ack.description: Acknowledgement of a write that took effect.

ok.description: Always `true`; a failed write answers an error status instead.

ApiArgWidth.description: Width of one argument in a record's payload, as the catalog names it.

oneOf.description: Unsigned 8-bit integer.
Unsigned 16-bit integer.
Unsigned 32-bit integer.
Signed 8-bit integer.
Signed 16-bit integer.
Signed 32-bit integer.
A temperature as a signed 32-bit integer in millidegrees Celsius.
A frequency as an unsigned 32-bit integer in kHz.
A voltage as an unsigned 32-bit integer in mV.
A power as an unsigned 32-bit integer in mW.
An efficiency as an unsigned 32-bit integer in mJ/TH.

ApiChainState.description: A chain's presence as the `/api/info` `chains[].state` string.

oneOf.description: No enumeration attempt has completed yet.
The chain answered with the expected chip count.
The connector answered with zero chips.
The chain failed enumeration or its safe-boot configuration.

ApiConfig.description:
HTTP API credentials: the user name and password a client
presents.

build.description:
The build id the board stamped: the tip of the checkout it was
built from and the build time, the same id the package file is
named by.

chain_voltage_mv.description:
Chain voltage, or zero where the board measures none. The body
carries it as integer millivolts under `chain_voltage_mv`.

chains.description: One entry per chain the board wired up, in chain order.

fan_pwm.description:
Fan PWM duty cycle, or zero where no fan reports. The body carries
it as integer percent.

fan_rpm.description:
Fan speed, or zero where no fan reports. The body carries it as
integer RPM.

hashrate.description: Sum of every chain's smoothed hashrate in hashes per second.

ip.description: IPv4 address as a dotted quad, or empty before DHCP assigns one.

mac.description:
MAC address as six colon-separated lowercase hex pairs, or empty
before the board publishes one.

mining_state.description: The miner's lifecycle state, or `null` before its first publish.

net_confirm_seconds.description:
Seconds left in the network confirm window, or zero when no change
is pending.

nominal_hashrate.description:
The hashrate the machine's maker rates it at, in hashes per second,
or `null` before a board publishes one.

ota.description:
OTA slot and session state. The key is left out on a board with no
OTA target, and the dashboard renders its firmware card only when
the key is present.

pause_reason.description:
The highest-priority active pause reason, or `null` when `paused`
is `false`.

paused.description: `true` while at least one pause reason is active.

pools.description: Bitmask of live pool slots: bit N is set when pool N is alive.

power_in_mw.description:
Supply input power, or zero before the first reading. The body
carries it as integer milliwatts under `power_in_mw`.

power_out_mw.description:
Supply output power, or zero before the first reading. The body
carries it as integer milliwatts under `power_out_mw`.

product_name.description:
The machine's product name as its maker names the model, or `null`
before a board publishes one.

psu_fault.description: `true` when the supply reports a sensor fault.

psu_voltage_measured_mv.description:
Output voltage the supply measured. The body carries it as
integer millivolts under `psu_voltage_measured_mv`.

psu_voltage_set_mv.description:
Output voltage the supply was set to. The body carries it as
integer millivolts under `psu_voltage_set_mv`.

running.description: `true` while the miner is in its running state.

time.description:
UTC wall-clock time as `HH:MM:SS UTC`, or empty before NTP
synchronizes.

uptime.description: Firmware uptime in whole seconds since boot.

ApiInfoChain.description: One chain's entry in the `/api/info` `chains` array.

chain.description: The chain's index on the board.

frequency_khz.description:
The chain's clock. The body carries it as integer kHz under
`frequency_khz`.

hashrate.description: The chain's smoothed hashrate in hashes per second.

hottest_c.description:
The chain's hottest die in whole degrees Celsius, or `null` before
a reading lands.

pool.description: The pool slot the chain mines for, or `null` when it mines for none.

state.description: The chain's most recently recorded presence.

ApiInfoOta.description:
The `/api/info` `ota` block: the slot state, the live upload session
and the reset diagnostics in one flat object.

bytesWritten.description: Bytes written in the current or most recent upload.

chunks.description: Chunks written in the current or most recent upload.

hasPreviousImage.description: `true` when the inactive slot holds a previous image.

lastError.description: Mapped error code of the last failed upload, or zero when none.

maxImageBytes.description: Largest image in bytes the board accepts for an upload.

phase.description: Phase of the current or most recent upload.

previousVersion.description: Version number of the previous image, or `null` when there is none.

resetOtaActive.description: `true` when an upload was active at the most recent reset.

resetOtaOffset.description: Byte offset the upload had reached at the most recent reset.

resetReason.description: Cause of the most recent reset.

resetWritePhase.description: Where in a flash write the most recent reset landed.

runningSlot.description: Label of the running firmware slot.

runningVersion.description: Version number embedded in the running image.

ApiMiningState.description:
The miner's lifecycle state as the `mining_state` string of both
info bodies.

oneOf.description: Chips are held in reset until a pool slot holds a job.
Bring-up is in progress.
Every present chain receives work.
Chips are held in reset, or no mining hardware is configured.

ApiPauseReason.description:
Why mining is paused, as the `pause_reason` string of both info
bodies. The dashboard reads these strings as an enum, so a rename
is a schema change.

oneOf.description: Chip temperature at or above the dangerous threshold.
Fan tachometer signal lost or out of range.
An operator asked for the halt.
A firmware update is erasing flash.
The tuner reported a fault it cannot recover from.
A temperature sensor that owes a reading is not giving one.

ApiSeverity.description: Severity of an event as the `sev` string.

oneOf.description: A state transition that needs no action.
A condition that warrants attention but did not stop mining.
A condition that stopped mining or caused a fault.

ConfigUpdate.description:
Partial-update wire shape for `GET` and `POST /api/config`.

Every key is optional, so a caller can patch one section at a time
without round-tripping unrelated state. A missing key leaves that
section unchanged; the POST handler merges only the keys present into
the running config. A GET response carries every section with
`api.password` blanked, so the stored secret never leaves the device.

api.description:
The API section; a missing key leaves it unchanged.

On `GET`, `password` is an empty string so the stored secret never
leaves the device.

cooling.description:
Partial cooling update: mode, setpoint, fixed duty and fan floor.
A missing key leaves the section unchanged. The PID gains are
factory-tuned and are not on the wire.

fee.description:
The entry the fee slot runs, which the board states and the
operator cannot edit. `GET` carries it beside the operator's
list, and leaves it out on a board with no fee slot. A `POST`
carries it back as served and the field is not even parsed, so
a `POST` of the `GET` body is an identity whatever the entry
holds.

fee_permille.description:
The share of the work the fee slot takes, in thousandths, which
the board states with the entry. `GET` carries it beside `fee`
and leaves it out with it, and a `POST` carries it back as
served and the field is not parsed, as `fee` is not.

miner.description: The miner section; a missing key leaves it unchanged.

network.description: The network section; a missing key leaves it unchanged.

pool.description:
The pool slots; a missing key leaves them unchanged. An empty array
means no pools configured and clears every persisted slot, which is
what the web UI sends when every URL input is blank.

thermal.description: The thermal section; a missing key leaves it unchanged.

CoolingBounds.description:
Accepted ranges for every numeric cooling field.

`mode` carries no range: it is an enumeration, and a value outside
it is rejected. The cooling validators check against these ranges
rather than against literals of their own, so this is the single
definition of what the firmware accepts, and the API reports it
beside the current config.

fixedFanPwm.description: Accepted range for `fixed_fan_pwm` as a duty percent.

minFanPwm.description: Accepted range for `pid.min_fan_pwm` as a duty percent.

CoolingInfo.description:
Static bounds metadata for the cooling config section.

Carries the accepted ranges of the cooling fields so a client can
take its input limits from the same source the firmware validates
against.

bounds.description: Accepted ranges for the cooling fields.

CoolingUpdate.description:
Partial-update cooling section of the config update.

Only the operator-tunable cooling fields are on the wire; the PID
gains are factory-set and never patched. Each key is optional so one
can be set without the others. `mode` and `fixed_fan_pwm` are separate
keys rather than one payload variant so the UI can edit the duty
without leaving auto control.

fixed_fan_pwm.description: The duty held in fixed mode, 0 to 100; a missing key leaves it.

min_fan_pwm.description: The fan floor in auto mode, 0 to 100; a missing key leaves it.

mode.description: The fan mode; a missing key leaves it.

target.description:
The reading the auto-mode PID follows and the temperature it holds;
a missing key leaves it.

DefaultTuning.description: The tuning a new config starts on.

oneOf.description: The board's default frequency and voltage.

The given PSU input power in mW, at the board's default
efficiency.

EventDefJson.description: One catalog entry: how to decode a record with this `code`.

args.description: Width of each arg in the payload, in order.

code.description: FNV-1a hash of the event slug.

fmt.description: Format string with one placeholder per arg.

EventRecordJson.description: One ring record. `args` is the raw payload as lower-case hex.

args.description:
Argument payload as lower-case hex, decoded with the widths the
catalog lists.

code.description: FNV-1a hash of the event slug, resolved through the catalog.

seq.description: Position in the ring, increasing by one per record.

ts.description: Timestamp of the record in the firmware's event clock.

events.description: Records after the cursor, oldest first.

FanMode.description:
How the cooling loop decides the fan duty.

`Auto` runs the PID against `target`; `Fixed` holds the fan at
`fixed_fan_pwm` and ignores the temperature. Neither mode disables
the cooling failsafes: a sensor fault and a stalled thermal task force
the fan to full in both.

oneOf.description: PID control against the thermal setpoint.
Operator-selected constant duty.

frequency_khz.description:
Target ASIC core frequency. The PLL grid steps by a fraction of
a megahertz, so a megahertz field cannot name every point on it.
It is stored and exchanged as integer kHz under `frequency_khz`.

voltage_mv.description:
Core supply voltage, stored and exchanged as integer mV under
`voltage_mv`.

GenericResponse.description:
A response body carrying a single human-readable message string.

Serialized as `{"message":"…"}`. Used wherever the firmware cannot
or does not perform the requested operation and needs to explain
why in a machine-readable envelope.

HwInfo.description:
Hardware-identification fields embedded in the system-info response.

`psuModel` is detected at runtime, at the PSU driver's first
successful init, and reads `null` where the supply is not
identifiable. `bootloaderVersion` and `fanControllerVersion` are
read once at boot, on the boards that have both, and are `null`
before that read and on every board that reports neither.
`hashboardIds` comes from every board's boot-time hashboard EEPROM
read the same way, `productName` from a board whose stored identity
names the machine, and `nominalHashrate` from a board that knows
the hashrate its maker rates the machine at.

bootloaderVersion.description:
Bootloader CRC-32 fingerprint as 8-char lowercase hex, or `null`
before the boot-time capture runs or on boards that do not
publish one.

chainsPresent.description:
Count of chains whose most recently recorded presence is
present.

fanControllerVersion.description:
Fan-controller co-processor version string, or `null`
before the boot-time capture runs or on boards that do not
publish one.

hashboardIds.description:
Per-chain hashboard serials, index-positional: element N is the
serial read off physical chain N. An element is `null` when that
chain's boot-time probe or read failed — an absent board and an
unreadable one both report `null`, distinct from a successful
read of a corrupt record, which still returns `"INVALID"`. The
whole field is `null` until the boot-time read publishes, and
stays `null` forever on a board with no EEPROM producer wired up.

nominalHashrate.description:
The hashrate the machine's maker rates it at, in hashes per
second, or `null` before the boot-time read publishes it and on
boards that publish none.

productName.description:
The machine's product name as its maker names the model, or
`null` before the boot-time read publishes it and on boards that
publish none.

psuModel.description:
PSU model name, detected at the PSU driver's first successful
init. A driver whose protocol exposes one reports the part
together with its revision letter. `null` where the supply is
not identifiable.

tuning.description: Tuner variant and target selected for the next bring-up.

MiningBounds.description:
Accepted ranges for each tuning target field, and the tuners a
tuning may select. The API reports them beside the current config.

frequencyKhz.description:
Accepted range for the target frequency. The API names it
`frequencyKhz`.

inputPowerMw.description:
Accepted range for the target input power. Present exactly when
one of `tuners` reads a power target. The API names it
`inputPowerMw`.

tuners.description:
The tuners the machine offers, in the order the mining form
shows them.

voltageMv.description:
Accepted range for the target voltage. The API names it
`voltageMv`.

MiningInfo.description:
Static capability metadata for the ASIC and board.

Groups the chip-specific constants (model, board name, swarm color,
chip count) with the tuning defaults and bounds so the REST API can
serve them from a single serializable value without touching runtime
state.

asicCount.description: Number of ASIC chips on the hashboard.

defaultEfficiencyMjPerTh.description:
Default power-target efficiency. The API names it
`defaultEfficiencyMjPerTh`.

defaultFrequencyKhz.description:
Default mining frequency. The API names it
`defaultFrequencyKhz`.

defaultTuning.description: The tuning a new config starts on.

defaultVoltageMv.description: Default core voltage. The API names it `defaultVoltageMv`.

deviceModel.description: Board product name reported to external clients.

swarmColor.description: Swarm color assigned to this device type for UI grouping.

NetworkConfig.description:
Network interface parameters for both IP assignment and hostname.

Stored with the config and applied at boot before the network stack
starts, so the stack sees the right mode on its first poll.

hostname.description:
mDNS hostname for the device; empty means use the build-time
default.

mode.description: IP assignment mode; defaults to DHCP.

NetworkMode.description:
Selects the IP address assignment mode and carries the parameters
for each variant.

oneOf.description: Address is assigned by a DHCP server on the local network.
Address is configured statically by the operator.

dns.description: DNS resolver addresses; up to three entries.

NetworkPostRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/system/network`.

Carries the network config fields beside `confirm_after_switch`,
which the caller always sends.

confirm_after_switch.description:
When `true`, arm the 120 s confirm-or-revert window. When `false`,
apply the change live and persist it immediately with no revert.

hostname.description: Desired hostname for the device on the network.

mode.description: Network mode to apply (DHCP or static).

OtaChunkAck.description: Acknowledgement of one accepted OTA chunk.

next.description:
Image offset the next chunk must start at; absent on the final
chunk, which ends the upload.

ok.description: Always `true`; a rejected chunk answers an error status instead.

OtaInfo.description:
OTA-related fields embedded in the system-info response.

Present on a board with a dual-slot layout, and absent on one
without.

hasPreviousImage.description: `true` when a previous image is present in the inactive slot.

maxImageBytes.description:
Maximum firmware image size in bytes this board accepts for an OTA
upload, so a client can cap its file picker at the real slot size.

previousVersion.description:
Version number of the image in the inactive slot, or `null`
when no previous image exists.

runningSlot.description: Label of the currently-running firmware slot, e.g. `"ACTIVE"`.

runningVersion.description: Version number embedded in the currently-running firmware image.

OtaPhase.description: Phase of the current or most recent firmware upload.

oneOf.description: No upload is in progress. The board is running normally.
An upload session is open and chunks are being received.

The last upload session ended with an error. `lastError` holds the
mapped error code.

The upload finished and the firmware is about to reboot into the
new image.

OtaWritePhase.description: Where in a flash write the most recent reset landed.

oneOf.description: No OTA write was in progress at the time of reset.

Reset occurred inside the flash write; the write had not returned
when the watchdog fired.

Reset occurred after the flash write returned successfully; the offset
was updated and the breadcrumb was written before the board reset.

A panic handler ran before the reset and recorded where the write
stood.

PidTarget.description:
What the cooling PID holds: one statistic of one kind of reading, at
one temperature. That kind is the only reading the PID follows.

host.description: DNS name or IPv4 literal of the pool host.

weight.description:
Scheduler dispatch weight for this slot. Zero marks a
backup-only slot, mined only while no weighted slot has work. A
missing key means zero, so a config without weights keeps the
primary-plus-backups behavior.

PowerTarget.description:
The power a power tuner holds the machine at.

PSU input power, so it is the figure a site meters and bills, not
the hashboard draw. What range a machine accepts follows from its
supply and its boards, and the tuner that reads this is the only
thing that knows it.

efficiency_mj_per_th.description:
Target input power per theoretical hashrate, which caps the clock
the tuner ramps to. It is stored and exchanged as integer mJ/TH
under `efficiency_mj_per_th`.

input_power_mw.description:
Target PSU input power, stored and exchanged as integer mW under
`input_power_mw`.

ProtocolKind.description:
Selects the pool mining protocol and carries its protocol-specific
parameters.

oneOf.description: Stratum V1 with an optional worker password.

password.description:
Worker password, or `null` to send none; most pools authorise
by worker name alone.

oneOf.description: Stratum V2 with an optional authority public key.

pool_pubkey.description:
The pool's authority public key as an SV2 base58check string,
which the client validates the pool's signature against, or
`null` to validate nothing. In flash it is the raw 32 bytes.

ResetReason.description: Cause of the most recent reset, as the watchdog hardware reported it.

oneOf.description: The reset reason was not read before this report.
Watchdog reason bits were both clear: power-on reset or `sys_reset`.
The watchdog timer reached zero before the next feed.
The watchdog force bit was set (software-triggered watchdog reset).

Source.description:
What a temperature reading measures. `metrics` in `ubos-thermal`
turns it into the `source` label.

oneOf.description: A sensor on the hashboard.
A chip's own die.

Statistic.description: Which reduction of one kind's readings the cooling PID follows.

oneOf.description: The hottest reading.
The mean of the readings.

asicCount.description: Number of BM1362 chips on the hashboard.

bestNonceDiff.description:
Best difficulty nonce found since boot; zero until the
scoreboard ring buffer is wired.

bestSessionNonceDiff.description:
Best difficulty nonce found in the current stratum session;
zero until the scoreboard ring buffer is wired.

boardName.description:
The control board's product name, as the board descriptor
spells it.

build.description:
The build id the board stamped: the tip of the checkout it was built
from and the build time, the same id the package file is named by.

defaultFrequencyKhz.description:
Default mining frequency programmed at boot. The body carries it
as integer kHz under `defaultFrequencyKhz`.

defaultVoltageMv.description:
Default ASIC core voltage programmed at boot. The body carries it
as integer millivolts under `defaultVoltageMv`.

fanPwmPercent.description:
Fan PWM duty cycle; zero if no fan is present. The body carries it
as integer percent under `fanPwmPercent`.

fanSpeedRpm.description:
Fan rotational speed; zero if no fan is present. The body carries
it as integer RPM under `fanSpeedRpm`.

hashrate.description: EWMA-smoothed mining rate in hashes per second.

hostname.description:
Network hostname: the configured hostname when one is saved,
else `boardName`.

hwInfo.description:
Hardware-identification fields: PSU model and the
boot-time-captured version strings a board may publish.

ip.description:
IPv4 address as a dotted-quad string, or empty if DHCP has not
yet assigned an address.

miningState.description: The miner's lifecycle state, or `null` before its first publish.

ota.description:
OTA slot information, or `null` on a board without a dual-slot
layout.

pauseReason.description:
The highest-priority active pause reason, or `null` when `paused`
is `false`.

paused.description:
`true` when mining is halted because at least one pause reason is
active; `false` when mining is running normally.

poolsBitmap.description:
Bitmask of connected pool slots; bit N is set when pool N is
alive.

sharesAccepted.description:
Accepted shares since boot, sourced from the stratum-client
session counter.

sharesRejected.description:
Rejected shares since boot, sourced from the stratum-client
session counter.

sharesTotal.description:
Total chip shares since boot, in units of 2^32 expected
hashes: a solution at chip difficulty `d` counts `d`.

time.description:
UTC wall-clock time as an `HH:MM:SS UTC` string, or empty if NTP
has not yet synchronized.

uptimeSeconds.description: Firmware uptime in whole seconds since boot.

SystemNetwork.description:
Live network status returned by `GET /api/system/network`.

`mode` reflects the currently configured IP assignment mode.
`pending` is `true` while a live change is awaiting operator
confirmation. `seconds_remaining` counts down to the automatic
revert; it is 0 when no change is pending.

The address fields carry the live values of the network stack in
both modes: static reports the configured values, DHCP the current
lease. Every address is `null` or empty until the stack holds one.

address.description: IPv4 address as four octets, or `null` when no address is assigned.

dns.description: DNS resolver addresses; each entry is four octets. Empty when none are configured.

gateway.description: Default gateway as four octets, or `null` when none is configured.

pending.description: Whether a live change is awaiting confirmation.

prefix_len.description: Network prefix length (1–32), or `null` when no address is assigned.

seconds_remaining.description: Seconds remaining in the confirm window, or 0 when nothing is pending.

SystemScoreboardEntry.description:
One entry in the best-shares scoreboard.

Fields match the stratum protocol metadata for the solution so
clients can reconstruct and verify the block candidate if needed.

difficulty.description: Share difficulty as an integer (not compact target).

extranonce2.description: Extranonce2 value used when the solution was found, hex-encoded.

jobId.description: Stratum job identifier for this solution.

ntime.description: `nTime` field from the solved block header.

rank.description: Position in the ranked list, starting at 1.

sinceSeconds.description: Seconds elapsed since this share was found.

versionBits.description: Version-rolling bits applied to the block header.

SystemStatistics.description:
Statistics time-series snapshot for `GET /api/system/statistics`.

`statistics` is an array of rows; each row holds one sample per
entry of `labels`, in that order. Until the server-side ring buffer
lands, `statistics` is always empty.

currentTimestamp.description:
Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds at the time of the
response; zero if NTP has not yet synchronized.

labels.description: Column label names; stable across firmware updates.

statistics.description:
Sample rows, one entry per historical snapshot. Empty until the
server-side ring buffer is wired in a later phase.

SystemTemperature.description:
The temperatures of the last thermal sample, the ambient reading and
the kind the cooling PID follows, returned by
`GET /api/system/temperature`. Each temperature is in whole degrees
Celsius, and one the last sample did not read is `null`.

ambient.description:
The ambient temperature around the board, or `null` where the
board measures none or the read failed.

chipMax.description: The hottest chip reading, or `null` when the sample read no chip.

hashboardMax.description:
The hottest hashboard reading, or `null` when the sample read no
hashboard sensor.

pidSource.description:
The kind of reading the cooling PID follows, or `null` under a
fixed duty and while a failsafe holds the fan at full.

ThermalBounds.description:
Accepted ranges for each thermal field. The API reports them beside
the current config.

ThermalConfig.description:
Tunable parameters for the thermal monitor loop. Temperatures are
in millidegrees Celsius.

cooldown_temp.description: Temperature below which a halted miner may resume.

dangerous_chip_temp.description:
Temperature above which mining is halted when the safety reading is
a real die temperature, or `null` on a machine that reads none. This
is the junction ceiling of the chip family, which the board
descriptor sets.

dangerous_hashboard_temp.description:
Temperature above which mining is halted when the safety reading is
a hashboard reading, or `null` on a machine that reads none. The
board descriptor sets it, and validation holds it at or below
`dangerous_chip_temp`.

ThermalInfo.description:
Static bounds metadata for the thermal config section.

Carries the accepted ranges of the thermal fields so a client can
take its input limits from the same source the firmware validates
against.

bounds.description: Accepted ranges for the thermal fields.

TunerInfo.description:
One tuner a machine offers: the tuning kind it reads, the name the
mining form shows for it, and the target fields it reads.

oneOf.description: Reads a fixed tuning, both its frequency and its voltage.

Reads a power tuning: its input power, and its efficiency when
`readsEfficiency` is set.

Tuning.description:
Tuner selection and target parameters used at bring-up.

A variant names a kind of tuning and carries that kind's target.
Which tuner a machine runs for a kind is the firmware's answer, and
a machine need not answer every kind: the firmware
lists the tuners it offers in the mining bounds. Changing the
variant tears down the chip and restarts under the tuner the
firmware selects for it; changing only the target does not, because
the running tuner reads it at its next step.

oneOf.description: Hold one frequency and one rail voltage, reached by a ramp.

Hold a power draw, leaving the frequency and the rail to the
tuner.
